description: Homogeneous / computer-graphics helpers (base/cg.rs): Matrix3::new_rotation, the Matrix4 rotation constructors, face_towards, look_at_rh, look_at_lh, transform_point and transform_vector of Matrix3 / Matrix4

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: matrix4_new_rotation
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_from_scaled_axis
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_from_axis_angle
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_from_euler_angles
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_new_rotation_wrt_point
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A + 32 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_face_towards
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_look_at_rh
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A + 32 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_look_at_lh
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A + 32 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix3_transform_point
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_transform_point
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix3_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A + 2 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A + 2 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
